row:
Hi, I'm Dr. Louis D'Amico DC, R.Ph, BS Pharm, and WELCOME to the Chippewa Chiropractic Clinic YouTube page! I believe as a society we must move away from a reactionary approach to disease, and toward a more proactive approach which emphasizes disease prevention and optimal wellness. 

At the Chippewa Chiropractic Clinic, we provide exceptional healthcare, delivered by compassionate people, in a warm and friendly environment. We have been a leader in the chiropractic field for over 20 years. My team and I work hard to provide patients with individualized care specially designed to reduce pain, restore optimal function, and improve overall wellness. 

If you like what you see on this channel, I invite you to call the office at 724-843-7255 and set up a free, no risk consultation! We are located in Beaver Falls, PA, USA - just 45 minutes from the city of Pittsburgh.
